description: Original solo-adventure bucket (loot pool) memberships, recovered from hearthstone.wiki.gg Card Buckets tables (as of 2026-11-10) and resolved to card ids in facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json. Primary cardId prefers the collectible original printing; collectible reprints (CORE/legacy) are alternates. Membership lists are the wiki's current tables and may reflect later patches.
method: Wiki tables were parsed from the rendered DOM (rowspan/colspan aware). Labels come from the reference CSV (category 'Bucket label') plus gap review Appendix C (Darius/Toki).

rules: Eight bosses per run; player starts at 15 Health and gains 5 per defeated boss (50 for the eighth).
Player starts with a 10-card class collection.
After each round: three bundles of three cards are offered; the player takes one bundle. The three cards in a bundle are drawn at random from one bucket and may include duplicate copies.
Bundles are themed; most buckets are class-specific (12 per class), built around archetypes up to Kobolds & Catacombs; some buckets mix in neutral cards.
After rounds 1 and 5: choose 1 of 3 Passive treasures. After rounds 3 and 7: choose 1 of 3 Treasure cards.

Mage, Priest and Warlock each have a 'Unique' (Highlander) bucket; the wiki notes these packs contain all such cards of the class including later expansions (current table: Zephrys the Great, Kazakus, Reno Jackson + one class card).

Some buckets contain a quest card (e.g. Druid 'Jungle Quest' contains Jungle Giants); the Tombs of Terror page says that unlike previous dungeon runs, quests are not offered automatically when a bucket is first taken, implying earlier runs did auto-offer them.

rules: Four hunters (Tess Greymane-Rogue, Darius Crowley-Warrior, Toki-Mage, Houndmaster Shaw-Hunter) with 11 buckets each, plus Hagatha final chapter.
After each round: three buckets of three cards each are offered; the player picks one. Cards are drawn randomly from the bucket; duplicates possible.
The wiki states buckets of a type picked before become more likely to reappear.
Player starts at 10 Health, +5 per boss (shared with Heist).
Passive treasures after rounds 1 and 5, Treasure cards after rounds 3 and 7 (same cadence as Dungeon Run).

rules: Nine classes, 10 buckets each listed per class on the wiki (CSV has 12 for Shaman; Jade Lotus and Mechanized are not on the Rumble Run page).
After each round: three bundles of three cards, pick one; cards drawn randomly from one bucket, duplicates possible.
Bundles tie to Shrine themes; each shrine seems more likely to offer bundles matching its theme.
After rounds 2 and 4: choose 1 of 3 Companion (Teammate) cards. After round 6: a Neutral Passive.

rules: Nine heroes (one per class), 12 buckets each, each class having a 'Legends' (Warlock: 'Legend') bucket.

Player starts with a 10-card deck chosen from three starting decks per hero: one available at start, one unlocked at 5 bosses defeated, one at 10 (e.g. Mage: Kindling Apprentice / The Elements / BURN!). The wiki lists these as fixed decks; no 'random cards' starter is described on the wiki page.
Player starts at 10 Health, +5 per boss (45 for the eighth); player always goes first; boss gets no Coin and starts with 1/2/3 extra mana crystals on rounds 6/7/8.
After each round: three bundles of three cards, pick one; cards drawn randomly from one bucket, duplicates possible.
Passive after rounds 1 and 5; Treasure card after rounds 3 and 7; Friendly Encounter (gold shop) between rounds 3-4 and 5-6.
Anomaly Mode uses a random Twist; ties allow retrying the round.

rules: Four dual-class explorers: Reno Jackson (Mage/Rogue), Sir Finley (Paladin/Shaman), Elise Starseeker (Druid/Priest), Brann Bronzebeard (Hunter/Warrior); 22 buckets each.
Each hero takes on two classes, so bucket cards come from either class plus neutrals; buckets are per hero, not per class.
Player chooses a Signature Treasure, a Hero Power and a starting 10-card deck (more decks unlock by bosses defeated).
After each round: three bundles of three cards, pick one; cards drawn randomly from one bucket, duplicates possible.
Unlike previous dungeon runs, quests are not offered automatically when a bucket is first taken.
Passive after rounds 1 and 5; Treasure after rounds 3 and 7; Friendly Encounter between rounds 3-4 and 5-6.
